description: The microtask-turns probes (skipped and todo tests, describe blocks, the run start, `done`, retries) under a custom environment whose `handleTestEvent` is an empty async function. jest-circus awaits the handler at every event, so each boundary gets the turns its events add: the count of events at a boundary is this golden's turns minus the plain fixture's. The environment extends `jest-environment-node`. One test file holds every section (the run-start chain reaches the first beforeAll).
